components.name: Metrics API
components.description: Provides resource metrics, commonly via metrics-server

components.name: HPA controller
components.description: Compares observed metrics with target utilization

components.name: Scheduler
components.description: Places Pods using requests and constraints

components.name: Kubelet + cgroups
components.description: Enforces CPU / memory limits; memory limit breach may OOM-kill

components.name: Pods
components.description: Replica count responds to scaling and scheduling capacity

operational_steps: Set CPU / memory requests and limits
Scheduler filters nodes by requests and constraints
Scale workload and observe capacity / throttling
failure_checkpoint: CPU throttling, OOM kill or HPA not scaling
recovery_path: Compare requests/limits with metrics, inspect HPA events and confirm Metrics API availability.
